scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Evenspaced including-endpoint one-dimensional exponential-kernel Gaussian-process integration with either a single rank-one shared observation offset or a separate independent-noise comparison.
scientific_integrity.limitations: Not a theorem for a constant latent kernel component, mixed independent-plus-common errors, irregular nodes, other target measures or other covariance kernels. Numerical checks are finite and historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Explicit AR(1) tridiagonal precision, exact integrated kernel mean, rank-one Sherman-Morrison reduction, sign factor, M-matrix comparison and signed weak measure limit.

title: A lengthscale-independent common-bias frontier for exponential-kernel quadrature
